name: WRBench
summary: 诊断相机运动过程中视频世界模型是否保持持久世界状态的相机可控生成基准。
summaryEn: A camera-controlled generation benchmark diagnosing whether video world models maintain persistent world state during camera motion.
scale: Natural-25 prompts plus videos, scores, and human annotations
scaleZh: Natural-25 提示集，以及视频、评分和人工标注
licenseZh: 代码采用 Apache-2.0；数据条款见发布页
access: Datasets, artifacts, and leaderboard available on Hugging Face
accessZh: Hugging Face 提供数据、评测产物和排行榜
verdict: 从六个维度检测世界状态持久性的相机运动诊断基准
verdictEn: A six-dimension camera-motion diagnostic for persistent world state
wmNote: 包含首帧、相机范围、视频、人工标注与冻结结果，复现链条完整。
wmNoteEn: First frames, camera scopes, videos, annotations, and frozen results provide a strong reproducibility chain.

evidence.sourceTitle: [2606.20545] Current World Models Lack a Persistent State Core
evidence.statement: Camera motion intervenes on observability to test persistent world-state evolution when targets leave and re-enter view.
